question: In December 2020, how many indigenous games were approved for inclusion as a part of the Khelo India Youth Games by the Sports Ministry of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Four**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Khelo India Scheme aims to encourage sports all over the country, thus allowing the population to harness the power of sports through its cross-cutting influence, namely holistic development of children & youth, community development, social integration, gender equality, healthy lifestyle, national pride and economic opportunities related to sports development.
 
• The Sports Ministry has approved the inclusion of four indigenous games to be a part of the Khelo India Youth Games 2021.
 
• The games include Gatka, Kalaripayattu, Thang-Ta, and Mallakhamba.
 
 
• Kalaripayattu has its origin in Kerala.
 
• Mallakhamba originates from Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Gatka originates from the state of Punjab.
 
• Thang-Ta originates from Manipur.​
 
 
 
• Sports Minister Kiren Rijiju has included Yogasana in Khelo India Youth Games 2021 in a bid to develop it as a competitive sport.
 
• Yogasana sport for both male and female categories has been included in Khelo India Youth Games, 2021.
